name: Evidence-pipeline benchmark
description: This record contains the complete reproducibility package accompanying the manuscript “The evidence pipeline shapes apparent predictability in literature-trained perovskite solar-cell stability prediction”. It evaluates whether literature-trained prediction of the time to 80% retained efficiency (T80) reflects transferable stability information or properties of the evidence pipeline itself. Version 2.0.0 expands the benchmark in three directions. First, a source-locked renewal cohort adds 21 papers and 57 T80 records beyond the original five-paper external stress test. Second, a strict 28-paper, 136-record analysis adds source-confirmed structured material descriptors. Third, a separate organic-photovoltaic application includes 11 eligible papers, 58 records and a five-paper holdout to test whether the evaluation logic transfers across domains. The package also contains the original 366-record development benchmark from 101 papers, the locked 142-record observation-model cohort from 42 papers, the original 15-endpoint final cohort from five studies, censoring-preserving endpoint tables, source coordinates, exclusion ledgers, paper-grouped evaluation code, censoring-aware accelerated failure-time models, leakage and feature-time diagnostics, frozen scoring, automated tests, figure source data and executable source for six main and four supplementary figures. Version 2.0.0 was privacy-sanitized and verified from a clean start.
